data.name: Kia Rio Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term Kia Rio hire across Melbourne. A light, economical small car and the lowest weekly rate in the fleet, at $160 a week.

mainEntity.name: How much does the Kia Rio cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Kia Rio is $160 per week including GST, the lowest weekly rate in our fleet, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.
Yes. The Rio is a small, light car that is economical for everyday driving.
Yes, the Rio is an automatic and seats 5 including the driver.

mainEntity.name: Is it good for students or new arrivals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Its low weekly rate makes it a popular choice for students, new arrivals and anyone on a budget, on flexible terms with no long lock-in contract.
